name: Local Grove Deli Style Flower | Count Chunkula
description: Genetics: Mochi Gelato x Runtz Breeder: Clearwater Genetics Selected by: Local Grove (seed hunt, in-house pheno) Aroma & Flavor: Chocolate and candy notes from dense purple buds Effects: Indica-leaning hybrid – relaxing and flavorful Count Chunkula is a decadent cross of Mochi Gelato and Runtz. This unique strain offers chocolate and candy aromas layered over vibrant purple buds.
